integrity: Proof includes explicit rational matrix and finite-distance attaining data. Exact-rational checker verifies finite cases; infinite-dimensional-count persistence is analytical. Independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact global sharp constants proved only for two through five observations; for larger samples only a universal lower bound is claimed. Equal spacings, unit data weights, real-valued observations. Historical originality risk remains.
title: First interior worst-case amplification in five-point convex regression
